description: FTPServer is the Schema for the FTPServer API

apiVersion.description: APIVersion defines the versioned schema of this representation of an object. Servers should convert recognized schemas to the latest internal value, and may reject unrecognized values. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#resources

kind.description: Kind is a string value representing the REST resource this object represents. Servers may infer this from the endpoint the client submits requests to. Cannot be updated. In CamelCase. More info: https://git.k8s.io/community/contributors/devel/sig-architecture/api-conventions.md#types-kinds

spec.description: FTPServerSpec defines the desired state of FTPServer

accessType.description: Required. The access type of the Server.

displayName.description: Optional. Display name of the Server

allowedCIDRBlocks.description: Optional. List of CIDR blocks that are allowed to access the Server. A CIDR range consists of an IP Address and a prefix length to construct the subnet mask. By default, the prefix length is 32 (i.e. matches a single IP address). For now, only IPV4 addresses are supported. Examples: "203.0.113.0/24" - matches with the IP addresses in the range 203.0.113.0 - 203.0.113.255. "0.0.0.0/0" - matches against any IP address. This field must contain at least one entry if the access type is EXTERNAL. The number of allowed CIDR blocks cannot exceed 500. Example: 192.168.0.0/16

consumerAcceptList.description: Required. A list of projects that are permitted to connect. At least one project is required in the allow list.

connectionLimit.description: Required. The connection limit for the consumer. Value must be greater than 0.

projectRef.description: The project ID or number of the consumer project. Must be in the format: `projects/{project}`.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

consumerRejectList.description: Optional. A list of projects that are denied connection. Format: "projects/sample_project_id" or "projects/1234567890" Projects in this list will be denied access, even if they are included in the `allow_list`. If this list is empty, no projects are explicitly rejected.

projectRef.description: The project ID or number of the consumer project. Must be in the format: `projects/{project}`.

external.description: The `projectID` field of a project, when not managed by Config Connector.

kind.description: The kind of the Project resource; optional but must be `Project` if provided.

location.description: The location that this resource belongs to.

projectRef.description: The Project that this resource belongs to.

resourceID.description: The FTPServer name. If not given, the metadata.name will be used.

status.description: FTPServerStatus defines the config connector machine state of FTPServer

conditions.description: Conditions represent the latest available observations of the object's current state.

lastTransitionTime.description: Last time the condition transitioned from one status to another.

message.description: Human-readable message indicating details about last transition.

reason.description: Unique, one-word, CamelCase reason for the condition's last transition.

status.description: Status is the status of the condition. Can be True, False, Unknown.

type.description: Type is the type of the condition.

externalRef.description: A unique specifier for the FTPServer resource in GCP.

observedGeneration.description: ObservedGeneration is the generation of the resource that was most recently observed by the Config Connector controller. If this is equal to metadata.generation, then that means that the current reported status reflects the most recent desired state of the resource.

observedState.description: ObservedState is the state of the resource as most recently observed in GCP.

createTime.description: Output only. [Output only] Create time stamp

ipAddress.description: Output only. IP address of the LB via which clients will connect.

googleManagedServerCredential.description: Output only. Credentials of the FTP Server.

asymmetricAlgorithm.description: Output only. Asymmetric algorithm used by the public key. Possible values (can be expanded in future): - ssh-ed25519

fingerprint.description: Output only. The fingerprint is a hash of the public key, and is displayed when clients access the server for the first time to verify the server's identity.

pscEndpoints.description: Output only. Details of endpoints created by the customer.

endpoint.description: Output only. This is a Resource name for Private Service Connect endpoint. Format: `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/forwardingRules/{forwarding_rule}`

network.description: Output only. The consumer network. Format: `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/networks/{network}`

status.description: Output only. The status of the connected endpoint.

serviceAttachment.description: Output only. The resource name of the service attachment. Format: `projects/{project}/regions/{region}/serviceAttachments/{service_attachment}`

serviceAgent.description: Output only. Service agent used to access the customer bucket.

state.description: Output only. The state of the server.

updateTime.description: Output only. [Output only] Update time stamp
